steps.label: manual
steps.html:
<html><body>
  <form>
    <fieldset>
      <legend>Your documents</legend>
      <input type="radio" name="resumeMethod" value="upload" data-automation="resume-upload-radio" id="r-up">
      <label for="r-up">Upload a new resume</label>
      <input type="file" name="resume" data-automation="resume-file-input" id="resume-file" accept="application/pdf" required>
      <textarea name="coverLetter" data-automation="coverLetterTextArea" aria-label="Write a cover letter"></textarea>
    </fieldset>
    <button data-automation="continue-button" type="button">Continue</button>
  </form>
</body></html>

steps.label: manual
steps.html:
<html><body>
  <form data-automation="questionnaire">
    <label for="q_1">Do you have full working rights in Australia?</label>
    <select id="q_1" name="q_1" required>
      <option>Select an option</option><option>Yes</option><option>No</option>
    </select>
    <label for="q_2">How many years of experience do you have with SQL?</label>
    <select id="q_2" name="q_2" required>
      <option>Select an option</option><option>None</option><option>1-2</option><option>3-5</option>
    </select>
    <label for="start">Preferred start date</label>
    <input type="date" id="start" name="start">
    <button data-automation="review-submit-application">Submit application</button>
  </form>
</body></html>
